d:
I didn't actually translate this myself, I just happened to come across a website where all the chapters where translated, so I downloaded all the pages from each chapter and merged them in order into one zip file since I usually download NSFW material I like for safe-keeping and accessibility's sake; sadly the worst outcome came to fruition when the website that had the translated chapters got taken down, and even though I tried to find another one that had them, somehow I found no website that had the chapters with the translation, so just in case something happens to the zip file I have, I wanted to make sure it's somewhere else as well as allowing everyone else to be able to access it; I would have also liked to be able to credit the original translator/s but either they didn't credit themselves in the original website, or I forgot to include the credits (if this is the case, I'm so sorry, I usually don't include the credits of the translation with the mangas I download since I use them for myself, I didn't expect that website to be shut down and essentially wipe this translation off of the face of the earth) So if anyone knows and/or wants to clarify who the original translators are, feel free to, it would be appreciated; Lastly I know for certain this translation was made by humans since I downloaded it two years ago or so, when AI-powered tranlation tools where nowhere near as advanced as they are now (to my knowledge).
Likewise I will probably not upload anything else since I don't actually do translations, unless something similar happens to another manga I happened to have archived, anyways hope you enjoy it
n: [Manga] [Derauea] My Neighbor Succubus-chan Complete ‖ Tonari no Succubus-chan Complete [English] [Decensored]
